title: Luminous Government & Regulated Infrastructure Control Evidence Matrix
scope: Traceable control intents and required evidence for civilian/public service, regulated enterprise and appropriate unclassified government IT. Not a certification, legal conclusion, system security plan or authorization.

references.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, including Update 1
references.applicability_note: Candidate control catalog; selects no baseline by itself and does not imply legal or agency applicability.

references.title: NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5 assessment procedures
references.applicability_note: Assessment procedures inform test design; current published release and agency tailoring must be checked before use.

references.title: NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1 Update 1 supply-chain risk management
references.applicability_note: Risk-management reference; not a product certification or authorization.

references.title: NIST SP 800-63B-4 authentication and authenticator management
references.applicability_note: Reference for digital identity; target assurance levels and use must be determined by the relying party.

references.title: NIST Cryptographic Module Validation Program validated-module database
references.applicability_note: Use only when the applicable jurisdiction or contract requires it; verify exact certificate, module version, mode and operational environment.

references.title: DPSA public-service information security and ICT standards index
references.authority: South African Department of Public Service and Administration
references.applicability_note: Index includes signed information-security directive material and older ICT security materials. Fetch actual documents and confirm current applicability with the agency.

references.title: DPSA Public Service Handbook 2024
references.authority: South African Department of Public Service and Administration
references.applicability_note: Useful discovery reference; confirm current circulars, directives and agency-specific rules before requirements are frozen.

references.title: ICASA type approval requirements
references.authority: Independent Communications Authority of South Africa
references.applicability_note: Confirm applicability to each radio/electronic communications product and exact SKU before import, sale, lease or operation in South Africa.

references.title: SITA effective panel contracts
references.applicability_note: Contract scope, dates, eligible suppliers and joining/procurement rules must be verified against live tender and panel documents.

references.title: SITA RFQ invitations
references.applicability_note: Time-sensitive market discovery only. Check the live pack, compulsory briefing, closing time and bidder eligibility; a listing is not an award or eligibility determination.

controls.title: Account lifecycle and privileged authentication
controls.intent: Every human and service identity has a named owner, least privilege, managed enrollment/revocation and authentication strength matched to risk.
controls.verification_method: Negative API/CLI tests for unauthenticated, cross-tenant, disabled and over-privileged principals; test enrollment, revocation, recovery and privileged MFA.
required_evidence: test results for unauthorized actions and revocation
open_gaps: Select an identity provider and authenticator policy for the target profile.
Verify end-to-end enforcement at the actual endpoint, switch, server and management interfaces.

controls.title: Break-glass credentials and recovery authority
controls.intent: Emergency access is individually attributable, limited in scope and duration, stored separately, rotated after use, and tested without reliance on the failed control plane.
controls.verification_method: Exercise recovery with WAN, central identity and normal management services unavailable; test authorization, audit record, credential rotation and return to steady state.
open_gaps: No production-grade independent recovery device or approved customer break-glass policy has been selected.

controls.title: Deterministic authorization for state-changing operations
controls.intent: Observations, events, tickets, model recommendations and API payloads do not themselves authorize privileged actions; the subsystem owning the state enforces explicit capability, precondition and actor checks.
controls.verification_method: Attempt stale-precondition, forged-actor, replayed and cross-tenant mutation paths; verify no state change without owning-service authorization.
open_gaps: Wire all products into the same reviewed authorization contract; do not accept caller-supplied tenant or identity fields as authority.

controls.title: Versioned configuration baseline and drift control
controls.intent: The declared configuration is canonical, revision-bound, diffable and recoverable; unsupported fields and ambiguous state transitions fail closed.
controls.verification_method: Validate exact schema/profile revision; inject unknown fields, stale generation, unreviewed drift and failed rollout; verify reject or controlled rollback.
open_gaps: The reference profile is a declaration, not yet a hardware-applied configuration.

controls.title: Firmware trust, secure boot and recovery
controls.intent: Boot integrity and firmware update assumptions are explicit per exact SKU; signed boot/update and recovery paths remain usable when an image is rejected or power is lost.
controls.verification_method: On exact hardware, verify firmware state, TPM, key enrollment, measured-boot reports where used, signed update, rollback protection and recovery from invalid image.
open_gaps: Framework NixOS Secure Boot path remains a configuration-specific qualification item; equivalent checks are needed for the exact server and gateway.

controls.title: Vulnerability response and controlled updates
controls.intent: Firmware, OS, application and third-party dependencies have tracked versions, an update policy, severity handling, exception expiry and an evidence-backed rollback plan.
controls.verification_method: Inject stale advisory data, missing deployed closure, expired exception and failed update; prove coverage is explicit and exceptions cannot suppress future findings.
open_gaps: No exact deployable system closure or end-to-end firmware inventory has been bound to a qualified pilot.

controls.title: Network segmentation and explicit traffic flows
controls.intent: Inter-zone traffic is default-deny; permitted flows are narrow, logged where material, and tested for IPv4 and IPv6 so that guest, IoT and quarantine networks cannot reach management or protected services.
controls.verification_method: Hardware-in-the-loop tests of access/trunk VLAN mapping, allowed/denied path matrix, IPv4/IPv6 private-prefix blocking, rogue DHCP and reset behavior.
required_evidence: packet capture for critical negative cases
open_gaps: The proposed eight VLANs and flow contracts have not been applied to or tested on selected hardware.

controls.title: Management plane and out-of-band isolation
controls.intent: Management access is not exposed directly to the Internet; privileged control paths are isolated, authenticated and logged; recovery does not silently depend on the production network.
controls.verification_method: Scan from WAN/staff/guest networks, try default and revoked credentials, and disconnect WAN/production LAN while recovering from local console/OOB.
open_gaps: The current lab profile explicitly lacks a physically independent OOB network/console server; local physical console is only an initial recovery path.

controls.title: Cryptographic algorithms, key lifecycle and validated module scope
controls.intent: Use maintained implementations; define generation, provisioning, storage, rotation, revocation, recovery and destruction of keys. Any required cryptographic-module validation is checked against the exact module/version/mode/environment.
controls.verification_method: Verify exact cryptographic module certificates where applicable, approved algorithms/modes, key custody and recovery; exercise key loss/revocation and encrypted restore.
required_evidence: certificate IDs and allowed scope where required
open_gaps: No concrete HSM/token SKU, key-custody design or jurisdiction-specific crypto requirement has been selected.

controls.title: Asset inventory, SBOM/HBOM and provenance
controls.intent: Every deployed unit and artifact is tied to exact model/revision, firmware/software version, supplier, orderable part, origin/provenance, warranty, end-of-support and replacement path.
controls.verification_method: Reconcile physical labels, supplier documents, serials, firmware versions and SBOM/HBOM; challenge unknown and substituted parts.
open_gaps: No purchased pilot inventory, complete HBOM or written supplier quote exists yet.

controls.title: Tamper-evident audit, time source and evidence receipt
controls.intent: Material actions record actor, policy decision, target, precondition, result, time/correlation, and versioned evidence; permissions and retention prevent unreviewed alteration.
controls.verification_method: Attempt direct mutation/deletion with runtime roles, inject clock skew and malformed receipts, and confirm event integrity, completeness and searchable history.
required_evidence: audit queries and storage privilege proof
open_gaps: A data schema is not proof that the deployed collector, storage and independent verifier preserve evidence.

controls.title: Monitoring, incident triage and response
controls.intent: Alerts and events feed a documented triage process with severity, accountable responder, evidence preservation, containment and closure; analytics do not independently execute privileged changes.
controls.verification_method: Replay known benign and malicious synthetic signals; confirm triage, provenance, case lifecycle and authorization boundaries.
open_gaps: No production SIEM or incident response provider has been selected; Symthaea outputs remain advisory.

controls.title: Encrypted, independent backup and verified restore
controls.intent: Backups have separate failure/credential domains, explicit key custody, retention and integrity; restore is regularly tested to measured RPO/RTO rather than inferred from backup completion.
controls.verification_method: Restore a known snapshot with production network disconnected; test corrupted, stale and missing key/media scenarios and measure recovery time.
open_gaps: Backup target, offline media, key custody and retention values remain unselected in the lab profile.

controls.title: Service continuity, power and environmental resilience
controls.intent: Power loss, thermal overload, WAN/control-plane loss and hardware failure produce predictable degraded behavior and safe recovery; UPS runtime is sized from measured load.
controls.verification_method: Measure loaded power, remove mains/WAN/management links, induce service failures and confirm orderly shutdown, local operation and recovery.
open_gaps: The APC SMV1500AI is an H0 candidate only; actual load, battery runtime, local support and monitoring-driver compatibility have not been tested.

controls.title: Data classification, minimization, retention and encryption
controls.intent: Each deployment declares permitted information classes, retention and sharing rules; the first lab uses only public/synthetic data and does not collect unnecessary endpoint content.
controls.verification_method: Inspect data flows, logs, retention and access; inject synthetic records and test export/deletion/media retirement according to the selected policy.
open_gaps: Agency-specific data classification, POPIA/privacy obligations and retention requirements must be determined for any real deployment.

controls.title: Physical access, tamper, maintenance and media disposal
controls.intent: Racks, rooms, console ports, removable media and device maintenance have named custodians, controlled access and auditable repair/retirement procedures.
controls.verification_method: Review site controls and custody; simulate lost/stolen device, unapproved repair, removable media loss and end-of-life sanitization.
open_gaps: No physical site or equipment-custody environment has been assessed.

controls.title: Supplier, vulnerability, license and end-of-support risk
controls.intent: Supplier risk, component substitution, license obligations, vulnerability disclosure, lead times and end-of-life dependencies are tracked and reviewed before procurement and upgrades.
controls.verification_method: Reconcile declared bill of materials and supplier paperwork; simulate unavailable part, substitute firmware and expired support; verify approvals and updated evidence.
open_gaps: Every hardware candidate remains H0/reference/gap; written quotes, contracts and lead times have not been verified.

controls.title: Radio equipment, electrical safety and jurisdiction-specific hardware approvals
controls.intent: Radio/wireless and power products have the approvals required for the destination jurisdiction and the exact SKU; importer/supplier and product obligations are identified.
controls.verification_method: Check exact model/hardware revision against applicable ICASA type-approval status and required labeling; review appropriate electrical/safety conformity and local procurement terms.
open_gaps: No selected AP/modem/UPS has been verified against a complete local compliance dossier; applicability must be confirmed by SKU and use.

controls.title: Incident records, outbox delivery, replay and reconciliation
controls.intent: Incident state and outbound events are replay-safe and ordered; every replay/redrive is authenticated, bounded, idempotent and attributable, with ambiguous external effects reconciled rather than blindly repeated.
controls.verification_method: Inject duplicate delivery, stale lease, dead letter, expired approval and uncertain remote acknowledgement; verify no skip-order or unauthorized replay.
open_gaps: The outbox API slice remains separate from production authenticated operator replay, provider integration and exact-head database qualification.

controls.title: Cloud/controller, external service and data-residency boundaries
controls.intent: Every external service dependency is explicit; hosted control is optional where promised; data location/retention, loss-of-service behavior and supplier obligations are assessed.
controls.verification_method: Disconnect WAN/provider endpoints, validate local configuration and recovery, inspect outbound telemetry and confirm allowed data flows and contracts.
open_gaps: The pilot requires local management, but actual controller behavior and outbound telemetry have not been verified on selected hardware.

controls.title: Build provenance, dependency and workflow integrity
controls.intent: Build/test evidence is tied to exact source and workflow revisions; pinned dependencies, actions, artifact hashes and runtime closure coverage are recorded; missing evidence is INCOMPLETE, never PASS.
applies_to: all platform repositories and hardware tooling
controls.verification_method: Test stale HEAD, lock drift, missing test output, queued/skipped job, malformed artifact, absent deployable closure and expired exception behavior.
open_gaps: The hardware-profile CI runs observed so far have remained pending with no job results; no exact-head validator pass is asserted.

controls.title: Tender scope, eligible supply route, warranty and contract-backed support
controls.intent: Each procurement opportunity is evaluated against the actual technical specification, eligible supplier channel, compulsory briefing, pricing/support duration and warranty; open-source publication is not a substitute for contractual obligations.
controls.verification_method: Read the live tender/panel documents and record deadlines, mandatory meetings, supplier eligibility, exact SKU/support terms and written quote.
open_gaps: Current panels/tenders are research leads only; Luminous supplier accreditation/eligibility and support capacity are not established.

controls.title: Independent evaluation, evidence quality and deployment authorization
controls.intent: Claims are scoped to a named deployment profile and exact tested revision; simulated/model results are distinct from runtime/hardware evidence, and customer authorization is a separate approval.
controls.verification_method: Attempt to advance maturity with only source files, schema validation, a queued CI job, simulation or missing scope; verify gate blocks promotion.
required_evidence: written authorizing official decision when required
open_gaps: No product or deployment profile has been independently assessed or authorized; current matrix is a baseline, not a compliance assertion.
